clue.text: Theatrical group supporting a doctrine

definitions.meaning: exaggerated, showy and affected in manner
a faction or side, as in the opposing ... of a debate

clue.text: Perfect job accommodating husband's breathing space

clue.text: Unhealthily pale savoury 20

clue.text: Feet of Cockney adopting current exercise system

explanation.definitionFit: Named after Joseph Pilates, it is a body-conditioning regime of controlled movements for core strength.

clue.text: Pressure person getting out of bed to hold onto captive
